morpheus.title: Morpheus
morpheus.subtitle: AI execution platform — plan, permission, execute, audit.

launcher.title: Actions
launcher.description: Every action asks for confirmation before it runs.

appLaunch.label: Launch an approved application
appLaunch.description: Starts an application from the built-in approved list.

fileCreateText.label: Create a text file
fileCreateText.description: Writes a new text file inside the approved Morpheus folder.

systemReport.label: Report system information
systemReport.description: Collects privacy-safe details about this machine's runtime.

fileReadText.label: Read a file
fileReadText.description: Reads a text file from the approved workspace.

fileList.label: List folder contents
fileList.description: Lists the files and folders in the approved workspace.

fileSearch.label: Find files by name
fileSearch.description: Searches file and folder names in the approved workspace.

fileAppendText.label: Append to a file
fileAppendText.description: Adds text to the end of an existing file. Nothing is overwritten.

fileMove.label: Move or rename
fileMove.description: Moves a file within the workspace. Refuses to overwrite anything.

fileCopy.label: Copy a file
fileCopy.description: Copies a file within the workspace. Refuses to overwrite anything.

folderCreate.label: Create a folder
folderCreate.description: Creates a folder in the approved workspace.

fileDelete.label: Delete permanently
fileDelete.description: Permanently removes a file or folder. This cannot be undone.

permission.title: Confirm this action
permission.noTarget: This action reads runtime information only. Nothing is written or launched.
permission.scopeNote: Saved decisions apply only to this exact action and target.
permission.degradedExplanation: Auditing is unavailable, so Morpheus is running in a reduced-capability state. Only privacy-safe read-only actions can run until auditing recovers.

strict.name: Strict
strict.description: Read-only checks run automatically. Everything that writes or launches asks every time.

balanced.name: Balanced
balanced.description: Read-only checks run automatically. Other actions ask the first time, and you can remember that decision for an exact target.

autonomous.name: Autonomous
autonomous.description: Low-risk actions run automatically. Other actions run only inside targets you have already trusted. High-risk actions always ask.

reasons.profile-auto: Ran automatically: allowed by the current profile
reasons.session-grant: Ran automatically: allowed for this session
reasons.persistent-grant: Ran automatically: saved approval for this exact target
reasons.mandatory-confirmation: Confirmation always required for this risk level

plan.title: Approve this plan
plan.description: Morpheus needs your permission for {{count}} new trust boundary(s) before running “{{objective}}”.
plan.mandatoryNote: This cannot be remembered and will be asked again next time.
plan.note: Everything else in this plan is already covered by your existing permissions.

groups.workspace.write: Create and change files in this workspace

timeline.title: Execution timeline
timeline.description: Live phases reported by the main process.
timeline.emptyDescription: Run an action to see its real execution phases here.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Append-only record. File content is never stored.
audit.emptyDescription: Every confirmed or denied action is recorded here.
